en: The front of the postcard is a collage of four images. The largest image shows a sandy beach lined with colorful umbrellas and mid-century modern hotels, with a backdrop of forested hills and more tall buildings. The other three images depict people dressed in traditional folk costumes, performing dances, and a large outdoor restaurant or gathering with tables and guests. There is Cyrillic text in bold at the center of the collage. The back of the postcard provides further text in Bulgarian, Russian, German, and English, referencing a folk style restaurant.
